INTRO AND RULES

This week, we welcome you all to our setting, the fictional Isle of Avon. The Isle of Avon is located here. and is subject to UK law.

About the Island

The Isle is 20 by 15 miles, making it slightly larger than the Isle of Wight. It is home to an extinct volcano, and is surrounded with beaches of dark sand, and covered in a patchwork of fields and orchards. It's main town, which will be named by player vote in this thread (please comment on my subsequent comment about this so we can keep the votes in one place), is on the East coast. Fishing villages thrive around the edges of the island, and farmers graze cattle and goats on common land near the mountain's summet.

The only way to reach the island is by airplane or by boat, and no island-based boats are capable of reaching the continent. The island has a small airport within reach of low budget carriers, which gives rise to a decent tourist trade. They are visited by cruise ships, and supplied by air and by ships from the mainland.

Islanders typically fall into the following categories: Farmers/ Fishermen; Shopkeepers/ Restaurant/ bar owners/ workers; Business owners/ office workers; Local police/ Fire/ Hospital/ medical personel; Taxi/ bus drivers / tourist herders.

--

HOW TO PLAY

1) Invent a character (multiple characters allowed, as long as you don't take advantage of this to fuck over other players) that fits within this setting, and describe their livelihood, family, where they live, and where they can be found. Link your bio in your first comment each week so that people can see who you are if they come in late.

2) Start your subsequent in-character comments with your character name, to make it easy for everyone to follow along.

3) Visit The Bar (below) to meet your new neighbors! The Bar will be a weekly comment thread that players can hang out in. Use it as a place to plan and stragegize, or just to RP with your fellow islanders.

4) Please post questions and out of character comments in the Discussion thread below.

5) To suggest and vote on town names, see the Town Name thread. Most upvoted name by the time I make the next post wins!

THE FIRST CHALLENGE WILL BE PROBABLY AT THE WEEKEND, OR WHEN I GET AROUND TO IT.

Have fun! :)
